name: Kuku Paka (East African Coconut Chicken Curry)
method: braise (sear chicken, simmer 30 min in coconut-tomato sauce)
nutrition_basis: published per serving at 6 servings; recipe states serves 4-6
ingredients: 4 chicken thigh fillets, skin-on and bone-in (~250g/8oz each)
1 tsp pure chilli powder or cayenne pepper
why: Genuine braised curry (chicken seared then simmered 30 min in coconut milk + crushed tomato); 12g carb, 38g protein per serving squarely low-carb high-protein. Adds African/Swahili cuisine variety the catalog lacks. All signature ingredients map to the board (chicken-thighs, coconut-oil, coconut-milk-canned, crushed tomato). CONFIDENCE NOTE: published 631 cal sits near the 650 ceiling (rich skin-on thighs + coconut oil + full-fat coconut milk); our computed macros could tip over, so selector should watch calories. Rice/flatbread are serve-alongside only, not in the dish.
